notes.content: PBT keycaps generally have a textured feel, are more durable, and do not develop a greasy shine over time compared to ABS keycaps ([expert-domain] RTINGS.com).
ABS keycaps typically have a smoother feel and are prone to developing an oily or greasy shine over time due to finger oils ([expert-domain] RTINGS.com).
Evoworks Evo75 is a mechanical keyboard with a 75-percent layout ([expert-domain] The Verge).
The Evoworks Evo75 costs approximately $170 and comes prebuilt with switches and keycaps ([expert-domain] The Verge).
The Evoworks Evo75 has an 'incredible build for $170' ([expert-domain] The Verge).
The Evoworks Evo75 includes Rye switches, which produce a 'thocky' typing tone ([expert-domain] The Verge).
The Nebula case color of the Evoworks Evo75 has a nice feel and subtle flecks of color ([expert-domain] The Verge).
The Evoworks Evo75 comes with a zip-up travel case and alternate Mac keycaps ([expert-domain] The Verge).
